name: Bulk Crap Uninstaller
description: 开源批量卸载工具，能清理残留、静默卸载和检测无效条目。
intro: Bulk Crap Uninstaller（BCUninstaller）是一款开源的批量卸载工具，可以一次卸载多个程序、检测卸载残留、静默卸载和清理无效的注册表条目。功能接近 HiBit Uninstaller，适合需要深度清理的用户，基于 Apache-2.0 协议开源。

en.name: Bulk Crap Uninstaller
en.description: Open-source bulk uninstaller with leftover cleanup and invalid-entry detection.
en.intro: Bulk Crap Uninstaller (BCUninstaller) is an open-source bulk uninstaller that removes many programs at once, detects leftovers, supports silent uninstall and cleans invalid registry entries. It is close to HiBit Uninstaller and licensed under Apache-2.0.

name: Geek Uninstaller
description: 轻量强力的卸载工具，支持强制卸载和残留清理。
intro: Geek Uninstaller 是一款轻量的卸载工具，支持强制卸载、清除注册表残留和卸载后自动扫描，界面简洁、免安装，适合替代系统自带的「程序和功能」。

en.name: Geek Uninstaller
en.description: Lightweight uninstaller with force removal and leftover cleanup.
en.intro: Geek Uninstaller is a lightweight uninstaller with force removal, registry leftover cleanup and automatic post-uninstall scanning. It is a portable single file and a good replacement for Windows' built-in Programs and Features.
